subject: english
question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Leisure
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Work'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Leisure"** refers to the time when one is not working or occupied; free time.(आराम)
 
• The word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to** "Leisure"** is: **'Work' .**
